original: ucyate | bhinnam atra darśanam | kecid āhur anyasmin kalpe vedās tenādhītās te ca mahāpralayena pralīnāḥ punar anyasmin kalpe suptapratibuddhavat sarvaṃ prathamaṃ pratibhāti, svapnapaṭhito yathā kasyacic chlokaḥ pratibhāti | bhāti ca vede "gaur anubandhyaḥ" (Śab 10.4.32), "aśvas tūparo gomṛgaḥ" (VS 24.1) ityādivākyebhyaḥ śabdānusmṛtipūrvakaṃ jhaṭ iti tān arthān smṛtvotpadyamānāṃś ca padārthān dṛṣṭvā "asyārthasyāyaṃ[54] śabdaḥ kalpāntare nāmāsīt, saṃpraty asyaiva kriyatām" ity ubhayaṃ vedaśabdebhya eva nāmāni karmāṇi ca sṛṣṭavān | atha vā naiva vedāḥ pralīyante mahāpralaye 'pi | yo 'sau puruṣaḥ keṣāṃcid iṣṭas tathā vedā āsate | sa evāntaraṇḍaṃ brahmākyaṃ puruṣaṃ nirmāya vedān adhyāpayāmāsa | evaṃ sa brahmā vedaśabdebhyaḥ sarvaṃ nirmitavān |

original: yad atra tattvaṃ tad asmābhir uktam eva | atha paurāṇikī prakriyā prayujyate | sāsmābhiḥ pradarśyata eva | ādau jagatsarga ity arthaḥ | atha vā, ādau yāni nāmāny anapabhraṣṭāni, na punar idānīṃtanāny aśaktijāni gavyādīni | pṛthak, na[55] yathā śarīraṃ ca tattvasamudāyarūpam[56] evaṃ[57] nirmame | kiṃ tarhi, pṛthak || 1.21 ||

original: karmātmānaḥ śarīriṇaḥ prāṇinaḥ karmasu tatparā manuṣyā ucyante | teṣām arthasiddhaye yajñam asṛjat | ye brahmopāsanāsv anabhiratāḥ[58] putrapaśvādiphalārthino dvaitapakṣāśritās te karmānuṣṭhānaparatvāt karmātmāna ucyante | ṣaṣṭhy api tādarthyaṃ brūta iti tadarthaṃ yajñam asṛjad iti gamyate | devānāṃ ca gaṇaṃ tadartham evāsṛjat | karmātmanāṃ cety ayam adeśe caḥ paṭhitaḥ | tasya deśo devānām ity ato 'nantaram | yajñaṃ sasarja | agnir agnīṣomāv indrāgnī ityādiṃ yajñasiddhyarthaṃ devānāṃ gaṇam asṛjat | tathā sādhyānāṃ devānāṃ gaṇam ity anuṣajyate | bhedenopādānam ahavirbhāktvāt teṣāṃ stutibhāja eva te kevalam | "yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ santi devāḥ" (RV 10.90.16) iti | "sādhyā vai nāma devāḥ" iti | "sādhyā vai nāma devā āsan" (PB 8.3.5) | atha vā brāhmaṇaparivrājakavat | sūkṣmaṃ maruto rudrāṅgirasa ity etadapekṣayā sādhyagaṇaḥ sūkṣmaḥ | sādhyagrahaṇaṃ cānyāsām apy ahaviḥsaṃbandhinīnāṃ devatānāṃ venostunītir ityādīnāṃ pradarśanārtham |
analyzed: karma ātmānaḥ śarīriṇaḥ prāṇinaḥ karmasu tatparāḥ manuṣyāḥ ucyante teṣām artha siddhaye yajñam asṛjat ye brahma upāsanāsu an abhiratāḥ putra paśu ādi phala arthinaḥ dvaita pakṣa āśritāḥ te karma anuṣṭhāna para tvāt karma ātmānaḥ ucyante ṣaṣṭhī api tādarthyam brūta iti tad artham yajñam asṛjat iti gamyate devānām ca gaṇam tad artham eva asṛjat karma ātmanām ca iti ayam adeśe caḥ paṭhitaḥ tasya deśaḥ devānām iti atas nantar

original: anye tu karmātmanāṃ devānāṃ prāṇinām iti samānādhikaraṇāni manyante | karmāṇi ātmā svabhāvapratilambho[59] yeṣāṃ te karmātmānaḥ | yāgādikarmanirvartanaparatvāt pradhānatayā vā karmātmānaḥ |
analyzed: anye tu karma ātmanām devānām prāṇinām iti samāna adhikaraṇāni manyante karmāṇi ātmā svabhāva pratilambhaḥ yeṣām te karma ātmānaḥ yāga ādi karma nirvartana para tvāt pradhāna tayā vā karma ātmānaḥ

original: kāścid devatā yāgādikarmaṇy eva svarūpata itihāse śrūyante | yathendro rudro viṣṇur iti | anyāsāṃ tu yāga eva devatātvaṃ na svarūpataḥ | akṣā grāvāṇo rathāṅgāni | na hi yathā bhārate indrādīnāṃ vṛtrādibhir asurair yuddhādi karma śrūyate tathākṣādīnāṃ varṇyate | asti ca sūkte haviḥsaṃbandhe teṣām api devatātvam | akṣāṇāṃ "prāvepā mā" (RV 10.34.1) iti | grāvṇāṃ "praite vadantu" (RV 10.94.1) iti | "vanaspate vīḍvaṅgaḥ" (RV 6.47.26) iti rathāṅgānām | ata eva prāṇinām iti | dvividhā hi devatāḥ prāṇavatyas tadrahitāś ca | yathendrādayaḥ puruṣavigrahāḥ prāṇavantaḥ purāṇe varṇyante, nākṣādayaḥ | itihāsadarśanāśrayaś[60] cāyaṃ sarvaḥ sargādiprapañcaḥ | casabdaś cātra draṣṭavyaḥ, prāṇinām aprāṇinām api | niruktadarśane 'pi dvividhā devatā | aśvāḥ "mā no 'mitraḥ" (RV 1.162.1) iti | śakuniḥ "kanikradad" (RV 5.83.1) iti | gāva "ā gāvo agman" iti (RV 6.28.2) | etāḥ prāṇavatyaḥ | aprāṇā uktāḥ | sanātanagrahaṇaṃ yajñaviśeṣaṇam | pūrvakalpe 'pi yajñasya bhāvāt pravāhanityatayā nityatvam || 1.22 ||
analyzed: kāścid devatāḥ yāga ādi karmaṇi eva svarūpataḥ itihāse śrūyante yathā indraḥ rudraḥ viṣṇuḥ iti anyāsām tu yāge eva devatā tvam na svarūpataḥ akṣāḥ grāvāṇaḥ ratha aṅgāni na hi yathā bhārate indra ādīnām vṛtra ādibhiḥ asuraiḥ yuddha ādi karma śrūyate tathā akṣa ādīnām varṇyate asti ca sūkte haviḥ saṃbandhe teṣām api devatā tvam akṣāṇām prāvepa mā RV iti grāvṇām pra ete vadantu RV 10941 iti vanaspate vīḍu aṅgaḥ RV

original: ṛtavo vasantādayaḥ | svaliṅgāni cihnāni patraphalakusumaśītoṣṇavarṣādīni | paryaye | yasyartor yaḥ paryāyaḥ svakāryāvasaras tasmin sa ṛtus taṃ dharmaṃ svayam eva pratipadyate, na puruṣaprayatnam apekṣate | cūtamañjaryo vasante svayam eva puṣyanti, na mūle salilasekam apekṣante | evaṃ puruṣakarmāṇy adṛṣṭāni | nāsti sa padārtho yo na karmāpekṣate | tathā hi | varṣāṇāṃ svasvabhāvo yo vṛṣṭipradaḥ, bhavati ca rājadoṣād rāṣṭradoṣād vā kadācid avagrahaḥ | tasmāt karmaśaktir evānapasāryā | vṛttānurodhād asakṛd anugrahaṇam |
analyzed: ṛtavaḥ vasanta ādayaḥ sva liṅgāni cihnāni patra phala kusuma śīta uṣṇa varṣa ādīni paryaye yasya ṛtoḥ yaḥ paryāyaḥ sva kārya avasaraḥ tasmin saḥ ṛtuḥ tam dharmam svayam eva pratipadyate na puruṣa prayatnam apekṣate cūta mañjaryaḥ vasante svayam eva puṣyanti na mūle salila sekam apekṣante evam puruṣa karmāṇi adṛṣṭāni na asti sa padārthaḥ yaḥ na karma apekṣate tathā hi varṣāṇām sva svabhāvaḥ yaḥ vṛṣṭi pradaḥ bhavati ca

original: anye tu ślokatrayam apy anyathā vyācakṣate | karmaśaktīnāṃ svabhāvaniyamo 'nenocyata ity āhuḥ |
analyzed: anye tu śloka trayam api anyathā vyācakṣate karma śaktīnām svabhāva niyamaḥ nena ucyate iti āhuḥ

original: (1.28) yat phalaṃ yasmin karmaṇy āhitaṃ prajāpatinā sa karmaviśeṣaḥ punaḥ punaḥ sṛjyamāno 'nuṣṭhīyamānaḥ svayaṃ tat phalaṃ bhajate dadātīty arthaḥ | tena yāgaḥ kṛto yadā phaliṣyati na tadā kiṃcid anyad apekṣata iti pratipāditaṃ bhavati | sevā hi svakṛtā api[76] mantripurohitādivākyam apekṣate | naivaṃ yāgaḥ | dṛṣṭas tu vyāpāras tenāpekṣyate | dṛṣṭādṛṣṭakāraṇadvayajanyatvāt sarvasya kāryasyādṛṣṭāntarāpekṣā niṣidhyate tadānīm |
analyzed: yat phalam yasmin karmaṇi āhitam prajāpatinā sa karma viśeṣaḥ punar punar sṛjyamānaḥ nuṣṭhīyamānaḥ svayam tat phalam bhajate dadāti iti arthaḥ tena yāgaḥ kṛtaḥ yadā phaliṣyati na tadā kiṃcid anyat apekṣate iti pratipāditam bhavati sevā hi sva kṛtā api mantri purohita ādi vākyam apekṣate na evam yāgaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tu vyāpāraḥ tena apekṣyate dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa kāraṇa dvaya janya tvāt sarvasya kāryasya adṛṣṭa antara apekṣā niṣid

original: (1.29) karmāṇīṣṭāniṣṭaphalapradāni vidhipratiṣedhaviṣayāṇi | karmāṇi dviśa udāharati | hiṃsrāhiṃsre iti | hiṃsā pratiṣiddhā | tasyā narakādiphalapradānaṃ niyamitam | yo brāhmaṇāyāvaguret yo māmakāyāvaguret taṃ śatena yātayād iti vākyaśeṣebhyaḥ | sā tataḥ svabhāvān na cyavate | prāyaścitteṣu viśeṣaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ | ahiṃsraṃ vihitam | tasyāpi neṣṭaphaladānāt svabhāvacyutir asti | dharmādharmayor eva viśeṣāyate | vihitaṃ karma dharmaḥ, pratiṣiddham adharmaḥ, tayor viśeṣāḥ satyānṛtādayaḥ | satyaṃ vihitam anṛtaṃ pratiṣiddham | evaṃ sarvāṇi pūrvottarapadāni vihitapratiṣiddhaviśeṣapradarśanāni |
analyzed: karmāṇi iṣṭa aniṣṭa phala pradāni vidhi pratiṣedha viṣayāṇi karmāṇi dviśas udāharati hiṃsra ahiṃsre iti hiṃsā pratiṣiddhā tasyāḥ naraka ādi phala pradānam niyamitam yaḥ brāhmaṇāya avaguret yaḥ māmakāya avaguret tam śatena yātayāt iti vākyaśeṣebhyaḥ sā tatas svabhāvāt na cyavate prāyaścitteṣu viśeṣam vakṣyāmaḥ ahiṃsram vihitam tasya api na iṣṭa phala dānāt svabhāva cyutiḥ asti dharma adharmayoḥ eva viśeṣāyate vihitam ka

analyzed: avyabhicarita dṛṣṭa kārya kāraṇa saṃbandhīni karmāṇi dṛṣṭāntaḥ yathā ṛtu liṅgāni iti śeṣam samānam

analyzed: lokānām tu vivṛddhi artham mukha bāhu ūru pādataḥ

analyzed: brāhmaṇam kṣatriyam vaiśyam śūdram ca niravartayat 131

original: pṛthivyādīnāṃ lokānāṃ vivṛddhyartham | vṛddhiḥ puṣṭir bāhulyaṃ vā | brāhmaṇādiṣu caturṣu varṇeṣu satsu trayāṇāṃ lokānāṃ vṛddhiḥ | "itaḥ pradānaṃ devā upajīvanti" (TS 3.2.9.7) | te ca yāgādyadhikṛtāḥ | atas taiḥ karma kṛtam ubhau lokau vardhayati | puruṣakarmapracoditā devāḥ | "ādityāj jāyate vṛṣṭiḥ" (MDh 3.66 [76]) iti, asyāpi lokasya vṛṣṭir[77] vṛddhiḥ | brāhmaṇādīn varṇān niravartayan nirvartitavān asṛjat | mukhabāhūrupādataḥ, yathākramaṃ mukhād brāhmaṇam, bāhubhyāṃ rājanyam, ūrubhyāṃ vaiśyam, śūdraṃ pādata iti | tasiḥ apādāne (Pāṇ 5.4.45) | kāraṇāt kāryaṃ niṣkṛṣyata iveti bhavati[78] | apāye sati apādānatvam | ādyaṃ kaṃcid brāhmaṇaṃ svamukhāvayavebhyo[79] daivyā śaktyā nirmitavān, adyatanānāṃ sarveṣāṃ mithunasaṃprayogadvāreṇa tattvebhya[80] utpattidarśanāt | paramārthataḥ stutir eṣā varṇānām utkarṣāpakarṣapradarśanārtham | sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prajāpatiḥ śreṣṭhas | tasyāpi sarveṣām aṅgānāṃ mukham | brāhmaṇo 'pi sarveṣāṃ varṇānāṃ praśasyatamaḥ | etena sāmānyena brahmamukhād utpanna ity ucyate | mukhakarmādhyāpanādyatiśayād vā mukhata ity ucyate | kṣatriyasyāpi bāhukarma yuddham | vaiśyasyāpy ūrukarma paśūn[81] rakṣato gobhiś carantībhir bhramaṇam, sthalapathavāripathādiṣu vāṇijyāyai gamanam | śūdrasya pādakarma śuśrūṣā || 1.31 ||

original: dvidhā kṛtvātmano deham ardhena puruṣo 'bhavat |
analyzed: dvidhā kṛtvā ātmanaḥ deham ardhena puruṣaḥ bhavat

original: ardhena nārī tasyāṃ sa virājam asṛjat prabhuḥ || 1.32 ||
analyzed: ardhena nārī tasyām sa virājam asṛjat prabhuḥ

original: eṣā sṛṣṭiḥ sākṣāt parasya puruṣasya | iyaṃ tu brahmaṇas tasyaivety anye | yat tad antaraṇḍaṃ samudgataṃ śarīraṃ tad dvidhā kṛtvā, ardhena puruṣo 'bhavat pumān saṃpannaḥ śukrasekasamarthaḥ | ardhena nārī gaurīśvarabhaṅgyā | atha vā pṛthag eva tāṃ nirmitavān | tāṃ nirmāya tasyāṃ maithunena dharmeṇa virāḍ iti yasya nāma prasiddhaṃ taṃ janitavān | etad ucyate | prajāpatiḥ svāṃ duhitaram agacchat | idam api jāyāpatyoḥ śarīramātrabhedāt sarvatra kāryeṣv avibhāgāt tadālambanaṃ dvaidhaṃkāravacanam || 1.32 ||
analyzed: eṣā sṛṣṭiḥ sākṣāt parasya puruṣasya iyam tu brahmaṇaḥ tasya eva iti anye yat tat antar aṇḍam samudgatam śarīram tat dvidhā kṛtvā ardhena puruṣaḥ bhavat pumān saṃpannaḥ śukra seka samarthaḥ ardhena nārī gaurīśvara bhaṅgyā atha vā pṛthak eva tām nirmitavān tām nirmāya tasyām maithunena dharmeṇa virāj iti yasya nāma prasiddham tam janitavān etat ucyate prajāpatiḥ svām duhitaram agacchat idam api jāyā patyoḥ śarīra mātra bhedāt

original: tapas taptvāsṛjad yaṃ tu sa svayaṃ puruṣo virāṭ |
analyzed: tapaḥ taptvā asṛjat yam tu sa svayam puruṣaḥ virāj

original: taṃ māṃ vittāsya sarvasya sraṣṭāraṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 1.33 ||
analyzed: tam mām vitta asya sarvasya sraṣṭāram dvijasattamāḥ

original: sa virāṭ tapas taptvā yaṃ puruṣam asṛjat taṃ māṃ vitta jānīdhvam | evaṃ smṛtiparaṃparayā nātra vaḥ kiṃcid aviditaṃ mama varṇayitavyam asti | tanmadhye śuddhim ātmana ācaṣṭe | asya sarvasya sraṣṭāram | anena sarvaśaktim āha | janmakarmātiśayavantaṃ māṃ pratyayitarīkariṣyatīty abhiprāyaḥ niścayotpattyarthaṃ ca, anyato 'vagate 'pi manujanmani svayam abhidhānāt | yathānyataḥ śruto 'pi kaścit pṛcchyate, "devadattasya tvaṃ putraḥ" iti, "bāḍham" iti tenokte niścaya upajāyate | abhijanavarṇanaṃ kavīnām atrapākaraṃ satyām api pāraṃparyeṇātmastutau | dvijasattamā ity āmantraṇam | sattamāḥ sādhutamāḥ sreṣṭhā iti yāvat || 1.33 ||
analyzed: sa virāj tapaḥ taptvā yam puruṣam asṛjat tam mām vitta jānīdhvam evam smṛti paraṃparayā na atra vaḥ kiṃcid a viditam mama varṇayitavyam asti tad madhye śuddhim ātmanaḥ ācaṣṭe asya sarvasya sraṣṭāram anena sarva śaktim āha janma karma atiśayavantam mām pratyayitarīkariṣyati iti abhiprāyaḥ niścaya utpatti artham ca anyatas manu janmani svayam abhidhānāt yathā anyatas kaścid pṛcchyate devadattasya tvam putraḥ iti bāḍham iti tena upadiśyate

original: ahaṃ prajāḥ sisṛkṣus tu tapas taptvā suduścaram |
analyzed: aham prajāḥ sisṛkṣuḥ tu tapaḥ taptvā su duścaram

analyzed: aham asṛjam utpāditavān daśa prajāpatīn mahā ṛṣīn āditas su duścaram tapaḥ kṛtvā suṣṭu duḥkhena tapaḥ caryate tipīḍā karam bahu kālam ca

analyzed: devān devanikāyān ca mahā ṛṣīn ca amita ojasaḥ

original: ete maharṣayaḥ saptānyān manūn asṛjan | adhikāraśabdo 'yaṃ manur iti | manvantare yasya prajāsarge tatsthitau vādhikāra uktena prakāreṇa sa manur ity ucyate | bhūritejasa amitaujasa iti caika evārthaḥ | ekaṃ prathamāntaṃ sraṣṭur viśeṣaṇam | dvitīyaṃ dvitīyāntaṃ sraṣṭavyānāṃ manvādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇam | nanu devā brahmaṇaiva sṛṣṭāḥ | satyaṃ, na sarve | aparimitā hi devasaṃghātāḥ | devanikāyā hi devasthānāni svargalokabrahmalokādīni || 1.36 ||
analyzed: ete mahā ṛṣayaḥ sapta anyān manūn asṛjan adhikāra śabdaḥ yam manuḥ iti manvantare yasya prajā sarge tad sthitau vā adhikāraḥ uktena prakāreṇa sa manuḥ iti ucyate bhūri tejasaḥ amita ojasaḥ iti ca ekaḥ eva arthaḥ ekam prathama antam sraṣṭuḥ viśeṣaṇam dvitīyam dvitīya antam sraṣṭavyānām manu ādīnām viśeṣaṇam nanu devāḥ brahmaṇā eva sṛṣṭāḥ satyam na sarve aparimitāḥ hi deva saṃghātāḥ deva nikāyāḥ hi deva sthānāni svarg

analyzed: yakṣa rakṣaḥ piśācān ca gandharva apsarasaḥ surān

analyzed: nāgān sarpān suparṇān ca pitṝṇām ca pṛthak gaṇān

original: yakṣādīnāṃ svarūpabhedaś cetihāsādipramāṇaka eva, na pratyakṣādīnām anyatamena pramāṇena paricchidyate | tatra vaiśravaṇānucarā yakṣāḥ | rakṣāṃsi vibhīṣaṇādayaḥ | tebhyaḥ krūratarāḥ piśācāḥ, aśucimarudeśādivāsino nikṛṣṭā yakṣarākṣasebhyaḥ | hiṃsrās tu sarva eva | chadmakaraṇena[83] kecit prāṇināṃ jīvam ākarṣanty adṛṣṭayā śaktyā vyādhīṃś ca janayantīty aitihāsikā mantravādinaś ca | gandharvā devānucarā gītanṛttapradhānāḥ | apsaraso devagaṇikā urvaśyādyāḥ | asurā devaśatravo vṛtravirocanahiraṇyākṣaprabhṛtayaḥ | nāgā vāsukitakṣādayaḥ | sarpāḥ prasiddhāḥ | suparṇāḥ pakṣiviśeṣā garutmatprabhṛtayaḥ | pitaraḥ somapājyapādināmānaḥ svasthāne devavad vartante | teṣāṃ gaṇam asṛjan || 1.37 ||
analyzed: yakṣa ādīnām svarūpa bhedaḥ ca itihāsa ādi pramāṇakaḥ eva na pratyakṣa ādīnām anyatamena pramāṇena paricchidyate tatra vaiśravaṇa anucarāḥ yakṣāḥ rakṣāṃsi vibhīṣaṇa ādayaḥ tebhyaḥ krūratarāḥ piśācāḥ aśuci maru deśa ādi vāsinaḥ nikṛṣṭāḥ yakṣa rākṣasebhyaḥ hiṃsrāḥ tu sarve eva chadma karaṇena kecid prāṇinām jīvam ākarṣanti adṛṣṭayā śaktyā vyādhīn ca janayanti iti aitihāsikāḥ mantra vādinaḥ ca gandh

original: vidyuto 'śanimeghāṃś ca rohitendradhanūṃṣi ca |
analyzed: vidyutaḥ śani meghān ca rohita indradhanūṃṣi ca

original: ulkānirghātaketūṃś ca jyotīṃṣy uccāvacāni ca || 1.38 ||
analyzed: ulkā nirghāta ketūn ca jyotīṃṣi uccāvacāni ca

original: meghodaradṛśyaṃ[84] madhyamaṃ jyotir vidyud ucyate | yasyās taḍitsaudāminītyādayaḥ paryāyā viśeṣāśrayāḥ | aśaniḥ śilābhūtā himakaṇikā sūkṣmadṛśyaś ca varṣadhārādivat patantyo vegavad vātapreritāḥ sasyādivināśinya ucyante | meghā abhrodakamarujjyotiḥsaṃghātā āntarikṣāḥ | rohitaṃ daṇḍākāram antarikṣe nīlalohitarūpaṃ kadācit dṛśyate | ādityamaṇḍalalagnaṃ kadācit, kadācit pradeśāntare 'pi | tasyaiva viśeṣa indradhanuḥ | vakratvaṃ dhanurākāratādhikāsya | ulkā saṃdhyāpradoṣādau visāriprabhāṇy utpāte dikṣu patanti yāni jyotīṃṣi dṛśyante | nirghātaḥ bhūmyantarikṣa utpātaśabdhaḥ | ketava utpāte dṛśyamānāni śikhāvanti jyotīṃṣi prasiddhāni | anyāny api dhruvāgastyārundhatīprabhṛtīni nānāprakārāṇi || 1.38 ||
analyzed: megha udara dṛśyam madhyamam jyotiḥ vidyut ucyate yasyāḥ taḍit saudāminī ityādayaḥ paryāyāḥ viśeṣa āśrayāḥ aśaniḥ śilā bhūtā himakaṇikā sūkṣma dṛśyaḥ ca varṣa dhārā ādi vat patantyaḥ vega vat vāta preritāḥ sasya ādi vināśinyaḥ ucyante meghāḥ abhra udaka marut jyotiḥ saṃghātāḥ āntarikṣāḥ rohitam daṇḍa ākāram antarikṣe nīla lohita rūpam kadācid dṛśyate āditya maṇḍala lagnam kadācid kadācid pradeśa antare tasya

analyzed: kiṃnarān vānarān matsyān vividhān ca vihaṅgamān

original: evaṃ kiṃcit sākṣāt kiṃcit prajāpatiniyogena sa bhagavān sarvam idaṃ jagat sṛṣṭvā utpādya māṃ ca jagatsthitau niyojya sve 'ntare[93] 'cintya āścaryarūpo mahān prabhāvaḥ parākramaḥ sarvaviṣayāśaktir yasya sa sṛṣṭvā antardadhe 'ntardhānaṃ kṛtavān icchāgṛhītaṃ śarīraṃ yogaśaktyojjhitvā punar aprakāśaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ | ātmanīti | yathānye bhāvāḥ prakṛtāv antardhīyanta evaṃ so 'nyatrety evaṃ na | kiṃ tarhy ātmany eva pralīnaḥ | na hi tasyānyā prakṛtir asti yatrāntardhīyeta, sarvabhūtānāṃ tatprakṛtitvāt | jagatsarvavyāpārān nivṛttir vāntardhānam | bhūyaḥ kālaṃ kālena pīḍayan | sṛṣṭvety etat kriyāpekṣaḥ śatā draṣṭavyaḥ | pralayakālaṃ sargasthitikālena vināśayan | bhūyaḥ punar ity arthaḥ | vakṣyati "anantā sargasaṃhārāḥ" iti || 1.51 ||

analyzed: sukham svapiti nirvṛtaḥ sukha svarūpam eva param brahma na tasya svāpa avasthāyām sukham anyadā duḥkham svāpaḥ ca tasya yādṛśaḥ sa prāk uktaḥ eva nirvṛtiḥ ca tasya sarvakālam na hi asau paramātmā avidyā upaplava taraṅgaiḥ āmṛśyate kevala sukha mayaḥ tasya sarvasya kartṛ tvam upapadyate yathā ayam puruṣaḥ uparataḥ gṛha kṛtyebhyaḥ kṛtakṛtya tayā arjitam mayā dhanam gṛha upayogi nirupadravaḥ ca asmi saṃvṛttaḥ iti evam sukham svapiti nirv

original: sāṃkhyā api kecin nāntarābhavam icchanti vindhyavāsiprabhṛtayaḥ | ko 'yam antarābhavo nāma | asmiñ charīre naṣṭe mātṛkukṣyādisthānaṃ dvitīyaśarīragrahaṇārthaṃ yāvan na prāptaṃ tāvad antarā nirupabhogaṃ[96] śarīram upajāyate sūkṣmaṃ yasya na kvacit saṃyogo nāgnyādidāho na mahābhūtaiḥ pratibandhaḥ | anye tu mūrtiṃ paramātmānam āhuḥ | sarvātmarūpaḥ paramātmā samudrasthānīyas tataḥ prādur bhavanti jīvā avidyāvaśād bhedam upayanti, mahodadher ivormayaḥ | tasya ca tato niṣkrāmataḥ puryaṣṭākākhyaṃ liṅgam abhyupagamyate | dharmādharmapūrvakṛtavaśāt[97] pratyekasya jīvasya vāsaḥsthānīyaṃ sūkṣmaṃ śarīram | yathā purāṇa uktam |

original: aṇvyaḥ sūkṣmā mātrā avayavā yasya so 'ṇumātrikaḥ | puryaṣṭakam antarābhavadeho vā, svabhāvata eva vātmānaḥ sūkṣmāḥ | yathoktam | "sa eṣa ātmāntarhṛdaye 'ṇīyān" ityādi (ChU 3.14.3) | bījaṃ śarīrotpattikāraṇam | sthāsnu vṛkṣādijanmahetubhūtam | cariṣṇu jagamam | samāviśaty adhitiṣṭhati pratinibadhyate | yadā tena saṃsṛṣṭaḥ prāṇādibhis tadā mūrtiṃ vimuñcaty ābadhnāti śarīraṃ gṛhṇātīty arthaḥ || 1.56 ||

analyzed: iha śāstra śabdena smārtaḥ vidhi pratiṣedha samūhaḥ ucyate na tu granthaḥ tasya manunā kṛta tvāt tathā hi mānavaḥ iti vyapadeśaḥ syaḥ itarathā hi hairaṇyagarbhaḥ iti vyapadiśyeta

original: kecit tu hiraṇyagarbhenāpi kṛte granthe manunā bahūnāṃ prakāśitatvāt tena vyapadeśo yujyata eva | yathā himavati prathamam upalabhyamānā gaṅgā, anyato 'py utpannā haimavatīti vyapadiśyate, yathā ca nityaṃ darśanāt kāṭhakaṃ pravacanaṃ kaṭhena vyapadeśaḥ | satsv apy anyeṣv adhyetṛṣv adhyāpayitṛṣu ca pravacanaprakarṣāt kaṭhena vyapadeśaḥ | nāradaś ca smarati: "śatasāhasro 'yaṃ granthaḥ prajāpatinā kṛtas tataḥ sa manvādibhiḥ krameṇa saṃkṣiptaḥ" iti | ato 'nyakṛtatve 'pi mānavavyapadeśo na viruddhaḥ | śāstraśabdena granthābhidhānam api śāsanarūpārthapratipādakatvād dṛṣṭam eva |
analyzed: kecid tu hiraṇyagarbhena api kṛte granthe manunā bahūnām prakāśita tvāt tena vyapadeśaḥ yujyate eva yathā himavati prathamam upalabhyamānā gaṅgā utpannā haimavatī iti vyapadiśyate yathā ca nityam darśanāt kāṭhakam pravacanam kaṭhena vyapadeśaḥ satsu api anyeṣu adhyetṛṣu adhyāpayitṛṣu ca pravacana prakarṣāt kaṭhena vyapadeśaḥ nāradaḥ ca smarati śata sāhasraḥ yam granthaḥ prajāpatinā kṛtaḥ tatas sa manu ādibhiḥ krameṇa saṃkṣiptaḥ ta
